title: Native Pi transcript, usage, compaction, and restart
summary: Pi JSONL is the complete conversation record while Koni binds attempt identity, authority context, usage, and terminal outcome.

assertions.description: Native Pi JSONL preserves complete user and assistant messages, reasoning visibility policy, tool calls/results, custom entries, compaction, and steering.
Usage separately retains input, cached input, output, reasoning, new-token, and total-token accounting without double count.
After compaction or restart, authoritative context and hashes are reissued by Koni; a summary never replaces them.
One immutable attempt owns one fresh linear Pi session; rework or revision creates a successor attempt instead of an authority-bearing session branch.
